statement: The system shall process loan applications in a timely manner.
The decision report shall include all relevant information about the applicant.
The system shall handle large volumes of applications.
Applicants shall be notified as appropriate when their application changes.
The application form shall be easy to use for most customers.
The customer portal shall have a modern look and feel.
The system shall respond promptly to eligibility requests.
Loan officers shall review flagged applications as needed.
The system shall support many document file types.
The branch dashboard shall show the key metrics.
Errors during submission shall be handled gracefully.
The system shall store applicant data securely.
The online application form shall be short.
The system shall minimise manual work for underwriters.
Where possible, the system shall pre-fill the applicant's details.
The system shall notify the applicant soon after the credit decision.
The approval workflow shall be flexible.
After review, it shall be sent to them by the system.
The system shall provide adequate logging of underwriting actions.
The system shall reject suspicious applications.
The system shall lock an applicant account after 5 consecutive failed sign-in attempts.
The system shall send a decision email to the applicant within 24 hours of the underwriter's decision.
The system shall display the application reference number on the submission confirmation page.
The system shall accept document uploads in PDF, JPEG or PNG format of up to 10 MB each.
The application form shall require the applicant's date of birth.
The system shall retain approved loan files for 7 years after the loan is repaid.
The underwriting console shall show the applicant's credit score next to each application.
The system shall encrypt stored applicant documents using AES-256.
The system shall generate a report of approved loans by branch on the first working day of each month.
The system shall reject applications from applicants younger than 18 years.
The system shall return the eligibility result within 3 seconds for 95% of requests.
Only users with the Underwriter role shall be able to approve a loan.
The system shall record the user ID and timestamp of every change to an application.
The system shall allow applicants to save a partially completed application and resume it within 30 days.
The system shall send an SMS reminder 3 days before each repayment due date.
The system shall calculate the monthly repayment from the loan amount, the annual interest rate and the loan term entered by the applicant.
The system shall export the list of pending applications as a CSV file.
The system shall display all monetary amounts in euros with two decimal places.
The system shall prevent submission of an application that has no signed consent declaration.
The system shall start the month-end batch run as soon as the finance team closes the monthly ledger.
